description:
Create accessible PDF documents directly from Microsoft Word.

axesWord is a Microsoft Word add-in that converts Word documents into accessible PDFs that meet PDF/UA and WCAG requirements.
New features
- Forms: Interactive, accessible PDF forms can be created directly from Word. Form fields are added in the Word document and exported as accessible form fields in the PDF.
- Page labels: Page labels are supported on export, so custom page numbering (e.g. Roman numerals for front matter) is reflected correctly in the PDF.
Improvements
- The file name can be edited directly in the export dialog.
- Support information can be generated from the Product Info dialog and shared with the support team when reporting issues.
- Improved support for bidirectional text.
- Improved support for rotated text.
Bug fixes
- Empty alternative texts are exported correctly to the PDF.
- Fixed an issue when inserting content controls in the context of role mapping assignment.
- The Span structure element is set correctly when multiple links appear in the same paragraph.
- The Update fields before export checkbox in the export dialog reliably updates all fields in the document.
- General bug fixes.
